text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Special honey lemon.
Hehe, I wonder if Trainer
will be happy with it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Lately, all she thinks about is racing.
Even right now, I'm sure she's—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To think I could forget something as vital as training...
This will never, ever happen again.
choice_data_list: Yeah. I appreciate the thought, though.
Yeah. I appreciate your kindness, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While grateful for the special drink...
I gave a stern warning to be careful.
